R25.quote: `strict_freshness`: `ExportDownloadsController` sends both ETag and Last-Modified. With this on, only `If-None-Match` is checked. The checksum ETag is enough, so behavior is the same.

Applicability: it names the right controller and gate but dismisses the effect. Recommendation: there is no explicit keep/adopt decision. Validation: no validators are tested.
